newsitem.title: UK: Burnfield drops LDS buy in line with buyout.
newsitem.headline: Burnfield drops LDS buy in line with buyout.

text.p: The new main owner of Burnfield Plc, electronics and engineering products manufacturer Fairey Plc, got its way on Thursday when a delayed Burnfield special general meeting decided to cancel a planned purchase and rights issue.
Burnfield had set up a deal to buy Ling Dynamic Systems (LDS) and make a rights issue before Fairey's hostile takeover bid succeeded earlier this month.

A statement from Fairey's bankers said that Burnfield's shareholders meeting had rejected both elements of the deal, and that as a result its offer for the firm had become unconditional in all respects and would remain open until further notice.
On January 20 Fairey said it had won acceptances for 67.63 percent of Burnfield's shares.
